sources.title: Redesigning the American Eagle Gold and Silver Coins
2021 American Eagle Silver Reverse Proof Two-Coin Set Designer Edition

verifiedClaims.claim: The American Silver Eagle program began in 1986; Weinman’s 1916 Walking Liberty half-dollar design is the basis of the obverse.
John Mercanti designed the heraldic eagle reverse used before the redesign; Emily Damstra designed the 2021 landing eagle and Michael Gaudioso sculpted it.
The 2021 two-coin reverse proof set paired original and new designs, with the original-design coin struck at West Point and the new-design coin at San Francisco; both were 99.9 percent silver.
